record.bible_text: The Spirit<WH07307> of the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> <FI>is<Fi> upon me; because the LORD<WH03068> hath anointed<WH04886><WTH8804> me to preach good tidings<WH01319><WTH8763> unto the meek<WH06035>; he hath sent<WH07971><WTH8804> me to bind up<WH02280><WTH8800> the brokenhearted<WH07665><WTH8737><WH03820>, to proclaim<WH07121><WTH8800> liberty<WH01865> to the captives<WH07617><WTH8803>, and the opening of the prison<WH06495> to <FI>them that are<Fi> bound<WH0631><WTH8803>;
